subtitle: Yenza amagama afundeke zombili
short_description: Hlela amagama amathathu ukuze imigqa nekholomu ihambisane.
description:
Ipuzzle yamagama esiNgisi: hlela amagama esiNgisi amathathu anezinhlamvu ezintathu ube yisikwele se-3×3 ukuze ikholomu ngayinye ifunde igama elifanayo nomugqa ofanayo.

Thepha amakhadi amagama angabekiwe ngokulandelana kusukela phezulu kuya phansi; ibhodi likhombisa umugqa ngamunye njengoba uwubeka.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
